gloss: very; extremely (emphatic variant of とても)

definitions.explanation: Casual, slightly more emphatic variant of とても. Used in everyday conversation and friendly writing to intensify adjectives, adverbs, and stative verbs.

examples.japanese: とっても⟦{楽|たの}しい→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧!
⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧とっても⟦{暖|あたた}かい→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧だ⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: It's a really warm day today, isn't it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦ケーキ→ケーキ：01356_keeki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧とっても⟦{美味|おい}しくて→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧、⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦あっという{間|ま}に→あっという間に：25467_attoiumani⟧⟦{食|た}べて→食べる：00396_taberu⟧しまった。
examples.english: The cake she made was so delicious that everyone finished it in no time.

notes:
Casual variant of ⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧ formed by gemination (small っ). Slightly warmer and more emphatic, common in spoken language and informal writing.

USAGE:
- Replaces ⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧ in casual speech; not typically used in formal/written contexts
- Like ⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧, in standard usage it modifies positive predicates; with negatives, ⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧ means 'not at all (possible)' (e.g., ⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{無理|むり}→無理：01558_muri⟧だ 'there's no way')

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- とっても⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧: really like
- とっても⟦{嬉|うれ}しい→嬉しい：00822_ureshii⟧: very happy
- とっても⟦{美味|おい}しい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧: really delicious
- とっても{綺麗|きれい}: really pretty

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧: very — the standard form; appropriate in any register
- ⟦すごく→すごい：01128_sugoi⟧: extremely — comparable casual intensifier, often interchangeable
- とっても is preferred when the speaker wants a slightly affectionate, childlike, or playful tone
